name: qa_cpu_moddrive
title: OS-BUG-MODDRIVE: the CPU of the step FX 38 / 39 on 1, 4 and 8 TB-303 tracks against the same song without them: opened from File, `cpu reset`, Play, 8 reads of `cpu` 2.5 s apart. ASSERTS underrun 0 and guard shed 0; the mean `render last` is reported. The project must be on the card first (`o3pj_tool gen moddrive1|4|8` and the `off` controls)

steps.say: QA-MOD-209 (OS-BUG-MODDRIVE): the CPU of FX 38 / 39 on module tracks. BEFORE the run: build the songs (`o3pj_tool gen moddrive4 <dir>/ModDrive4/project.o3pj`, `gen moddrive4off <dir>/ModDrive4off/project.o3pj`, and 1 and 8 the same; no samples) and copy ONE folder into Projects/ per run, 1, 4 and 8 with the FX, then each control. Use the release image.

steps.note: (Shift released, in case a former run left it down)
(a leftover Navigator is closed: F7 is CLOSE, F8 would GO since OS-NAV2)
(a leftover overlay is put away: F8 is Back)
(the on-screen keyboard is cancelled with F7, never accepted)
the cursor to the first entry
Down until the cursor is on the project (150 rounds at most: more projects than that on the card and it stops here, nothing opens)
the song is opening (the strip may already read PROJECT_<name>_OPENED on the unit)
(the load line says `N values reset` when a chunk had values out of range)
(soft: the TB-303 and the FM instance are bound; a muted module says so here)
arm M: render last / max, underruns, the guard's shed blocks (the last read is kept in the report)
the mean of the 8 reads of `render last` (cycles): REPORTED, compare the FX project with its `off` control
module instances and cycles per voice
the governor: how many instances it admits (the shaping lands in its base)
